Why Independent

Here's What We Give You That A Captive Agency Won't

Carrier Access

We're appointed with 4+ national and regional life carriers. You sell what's right for your client — not whatever one carrier happens to offer.

Keep More Money

Our override structure means you take home a larger percentage of every dollar you produce. No hidden fees, no production quotas that reset unfairly.

Built-In Support

Commission disputes handled. Compliance questions answered. E&O coverage included. You sell — we handle everything behind the scenes.
